categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 今天这批论文一边在抠推理效率与Agent的输出可控性，一边把AI往教育、小语种等真实场景里推。

articles.title: Learning to Stop without Learning to Stop: Self-Supervised Confidence Training Improves Reasoning Efficiency
articles.zh: 不学"停"也能学会停：自监督置信度训练提升推理效率
articles.summary: 如果你在愁推理模型想太久、Token烧太多，这篇告诉你不用额外训练停止策略，只靠置信度自监督就能让它该停就停
articles.author: Parsa Hosseini, Akasha Tigalappanavara 等
articles.body: Reasoning models often generate very long reasoning traces, making inference computationally expensive. Existing approaches typically improve efficiency either through inference-time early-stopping mechanisms or by explicitly encouraging shorter reasoning during training, for example through reinforcement learning with length penalties. We show that substantial efficiency gains can instead emerge from a different kind of supervision: \textit{confidence}. Using a self-supervised procedure, we fine-tune reasoning models to predict their confidence in the answer at intermediate points along their own reasoning trajectories using only 600 training problems. Confidence is used only as a training target: the loss contains no objective for reasoning length, efficiency, or stopping. At inference, the fine-tuned models use the standard generation procedure, with no confidence elicitation or early-stopping mechanism. Despite this, self-supervised confidence fine-tuning makes reasoning more efficient, reducing generated tokens by up to 25\% at matched accuracy across Gemma, Qwen, Nemotron, and GPT-OSS models on mathematical, scientific, and coding reasoning benchmarks, with efficiency gains comparable to methods that explicitly optimize for shorter reasoning. Analysis of reasoning episodes further shows that confidence supervision largely preserves the base models' high-level reasoning composition rather than selectively suppressing particular behaviors. Our results suggest that efficient reasoning may emerge as a downstream consequence of learning metacognitive signals, without being directly optimized.
articles.bodyZh: 推理模型往往会生成特别长的推理过程，导致推理计算成本很高。现有方法通常要么在推理阶段做提前停止，要么在训练时明确鼓励更短的推理，比如用带长度惩罚的强化学习。我们则证明，还有另一种监督信号能带来可观的效率提升：\textit{置信度}。我们采用一种自监督流程，只用600道训练题，就微调推理模型，让它们在自己推理轨迹的中间点上预测对答案的置信度。置信度只被当作训练目标：损失函数里完全没有针对推理长度、效率或停止的目标。到了推理阶段，微调后的模型仍然使用标准生成流程，不做置信度引导，也没有提前停止机制。即便如此，自监督置信度微调还是让推理更高效了：在数学、科学和编程推理基准上，Gemma、Qwen、Nemotron 和 GPT-OSS 模型在保持相同准确率的情况下，生成 token 最多减少了25\%，效率提升幅度和那些明确优化短推理的方法相当。对推理片段的分析进一步表明，置信度监督大体上保留了基础模型的高层推理组成，而不是有选择地压制某些行为。我们的结果表明，高效推理可能是学习元认知信号后的一个下游结果，而不是被直接优化出来的。

articles.title: Statistical attribute alignment for black-box generative AI via output post-processing
articles.zh: 通过输出后处理实现黑盒生成式AI的统计属性对齐
articles.summary: 如果你只能调用别人的API、拿不到模型权重，这个方法能在输出端把生成结果的统计分布掰到你要的样子
articles.author: Kevin Jiang, Morgane Austern 等
articles.body: Generative AI systems are increasingly used, but aligning their outputs with user requirements poses a continuing challenge. Here, we aim to ensure that the distribution of an attribute of an AI-generated output aligns with a user-specified target. This is motivated by examples such as fairness, where we want to ensure that a protected attribute (e.g., gender, race, or age categories) follows a desired distribution, and synthetic data generation, where we want the generated data to be representative of a target distribution. We study the practically important black-box access setting, where a user can repeatedly query a generative AI model. The goal is to return $m\ge 1$ outputs whose joint attribute distribution is as close as possible to this target. For both exact and approximate alignment, we develop algorithms that minimize the expected number of queries to the generator, and we further demonstrate their optimality as the number of requested outputs $m \rightarrow \infty$. Experiments on text-to-image generation and geocoded persona generation tasks show that our post-processing algorithms improve statistical attribute alignment, complementing prompting-based interventions.
articles.bodyZh: 生成式AI系统（generative AI systems）用得越来越多，但怎么让它们生成的内容跟用户需求对齐，始终是个难题。我们这里想解决的是：让AI生成结果里某个属性的分布，跟用户指定的目标分布对得上。这么做是有现实例子的，比如在公平性（fairness）里，我们希望某个受保护属性（protected attribute，比如性别、种族或年龄类别）能符合想要的分布；再比如合成数据生成（synthetic data generation），我们希望生成的数据能代表某个目标分布。我们研究的是一个很实际、也很重要的黑盒访问（black-box access）场景：用户能反复向一个生成式AI模型（generative AI model）提问。目标呢，是返回 m≥1 个输出，让它们合起来的联合属性分布（joint attribute distribution）尽可能接近这个目标分布。不管是精确对齐（exact alignment）还是近似对齐（approximate alignment），我们都提出了算法，能把向生成器查询（queries）的期望次数降到最低；而且我们还证明了，当用户要的输出数量 m 越来越大、趋向无穷时，这些算法是最优的。我们在文本到图像生成（text-to-image generation）和地理编码人物生成（geocoded persona generation）任务上做了实验，结果显示，我们的后处理算法（post-processing algorithms）能改善统计属性对齐（statistical attribute alignment），也能跟基于提示的干预（prompting-based interventions）形成互补。

articles.title: User Model Extraction via Belief Self-Distillation
articles.zh: 基于信念自蒸馏的用户模型抽取
articles.summary: 如果你在做个性化Agent又懒得问用户，这篇让你从对话里把用户的偏好模型蒸馏出来
articles.author: Ali Holmov, Yiran Huang 等
articles.body: Large language models (LLMs) implicitly infer attributes of their users and adapt their behavior accordingly, yet these beliefs remain difficult to inspect and causally manipulate. We introduce Belief Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified read-write framework that bridges linear and causal probing by learning a compact user representation that can be both decoded and written back into the model. The frozen LLM acts as its own teacher, distilling beliefs from natural conversations without external annotations. Unlike conventional probing, BSD isolates not only information present in activations, but a state whose causal role can be directly tested. Across multiple model families, BSD faithfully recovers user beliefs and enables substantially stronger interventions than matched hidden-state steering. Crucially, we find that refusal depends not only on the request, but on the model's inferred user intent: changing this belief alters refusal while holding the request fixed. We further uncover a striking cross-model regularity: independently trained LLMs converge on a shared geometry for representing their users. Together, these results reveal implicit user models as readable and causally writable internal states with direct implications for AI safety, shaping how models condition safety decisions on whom they believe they are interacting with.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLMs）会暗中推断用户身上的一些特征，然后据此调整自己的行为。可问题是，这些“它以为你是谁”的看法，我们既很难查看，也很难从因果上动手改。为此，我们提出了“信念自蒸馏”（Belief Self-Distillation, BSD）——一个统一的“读—写”框架，把线性探针和因果探针（linear and causal probing）连接了起来：它会学出一个紧凑的用户表征（user representation），这个表征既能被解码出来，也能再写回模型里。冻结住的大语言模型自己当自己的老师，不需要外部标注，就能从自然对话里蒸馏出这些信念。和传统探针不一样，BSD 不只把激活值（activations）里已有的信息单独拎出来，还能找出一种状态，并且直接测试它到底有没有因果作用。在多个模型家族上，BSD 都能忠实还原用户信念，而且能做比“匹配的隐状态引导”（hidden-state steering）强得多的干预。最关键的是，我们发现模型拒答（refusal）不只是看请求本身，还要看它推断出的用户意图：请求不变，只改这个信念，拒答就会变。我们还发现一个很惊人的跨模型规律（cross-model regularity）：各自独立训练出来的大语言模型，在表示用户这件事上，居然会收敛到一套共通的几何结构（geometry）。合在一起，这些结果说明，模型心里的“隐式用户模型”（implicit user models）是一种可读、也能从因果上写入的内部状态。这对 AI 安全（AI safety）有直接意义：它会影响模型在决定安全策略时，究竟是根据它以为自己在跟谁说话来做判断。

articles.title: Compact Documentation for Coding Agents: A Benchmark, an Optimizer, and Why It Does Not Transfer
articles.zh: 面向编程Agent的精简文档：一个基准、一个优化器，以及它为何无法迁移
articles.summary: 如果你正打算给编程Agent自动精简文档省Token，这篇的诚实结论是——优化出来的东西换个场景就失效
articles.author: Md Shohel Arman, Igor Molybog
articles.body: We investigate whether natural-language documentation helps coding agents resolve software issues, and we build the tools to construct and evaluate it. We introduce a roundtrip benchmark that scores code descriptions by whether code regenerated from them passes the original tests, and show that completeness, not length, drives a description's fidelity. Using the benchmark as an optimization signal, we discover a description-writing prompt that reaches full fidelity and generalizes to unseen files. We then test the hypothesis that motivated the work: that better documentation helps an agent resolve real repository issues. Across two model families and ten repositories, and against a positive control confirming that our evaluation can detect a genuine improvement, we find that it does not. When the source is present, neither static compact documentation nor retrieved context beats the issue alone. We report this negative result together with the benchmark and the optimizer, and we characterize the boundary at which documentation helps.
articles.bodyZh: 我们想弄明白：自然语言文档（natural-language documentation）到底能不能帮编程智能体（coding agents）解决软件问题（software issues），也顺手把构建和评估这类文档的工具做了出来。我们提出一个往返基准测试（roundtrip benchmark）：给一段代码描述打分，就看按它重新生成的代码能不能通过原来的测试。结果发现，真正决定一段描述保真度（fidelity）的，是它够不够完整，而不是长不长。拿这个基准当优化信号（optimization signal），我们找到了一个写描述的提示词（description-writing prompt），它能让描述达到完全保真，还能泛化到没见过的文件上。接着，我们验证了最初推动这项工作的假设：更好的文档能帮智能体解决真实代码仓库（repositories）里的问题。我们在两种模型家族（model families）、十个代码仓库上做了测试，还设置了阳性对照（positive control），确认我们的评估确实能检测到真实提升。可结果是：这个假设不成立。当源代码（source）就在眼前时，不管是静态精简文档（static compact documentation），还是检索出来的上下文（retrieved context），都不比只给问题本身更好。我们把这个负面结果（negative result）报告出来，也一并给出基准测试和优化器（optimizer），并说明文档到底在什么边界（boundary）条件下才有帮助。

articles.title: OC-GS: Gaussian Splatting for Irregular Turntable Capture
articles.zh: OC-GS：面向非规则转台拍摄的高斯泼溅重建
articles.summary: 如果你拍物体时转台转得歪歪扭扭、角度不均，这套高斯泼溅方案专门治这种不规整的采集数据
articles.author: Jae Joong Lee, Bedrich Benes
articles.body: Uneven rotation and dropped frames make equal-angle assumptions unreliable for turntable reconstruction. We present OC-GS, an object-centric Gaussian splatting that refines each image's angle while maintaining a shared camera, rotation axis, and pivot. This orbit-consistent refinement jointly optimizes image-derived geometry and angles to reconstruct objects from sparse, irregular captures. On rendered objects with 12, 8, and 6 irregularly spaced views, OC-GS achieves mean foreground PSNR scores of 21.26, 19.36, and 15.83dB, respectively, exceeding all four evaluated pose-free Gaussian splatting baselines in each condition. Under a shared trainer, refining image-estimated angles improves mean foreground PSNR by 7.88dB over keeping those estimates fixed. An ablation study shows that both image-derived angle initialization and the shared motion model contribute to the improvement. On real captures, OC-GS's refinement increases mean foreground PSNR by 0.70dB. Results show that refining uncertain angles within a shared motion model improves reconstruction from sparse, irregular turntable captures.
articles.bodyZh: 旋转不均、丢帧，会让“每张图之间角度相等”这个假设在转台重建（turntable reconstruction）里很不可靠。为此我们提出 OC-GS：一种以物体为中心的高斯泼溅（Gaussian splatting），它会在共享相机、共享旋转轴和共享支点（pivot）的前提下，逐张图去修正角度。这种轨道一致的（orbit-consistent）修正，会把从图像推出来的几何和角度放到一起优化，从而用稀疏、不规则的拍摄把物体重建出来。在渲染物体上，只用 12、8、6 个间距不规则的视角时，OC-GS 的平均前景 PSNR（peak signal-to-noise ratio）得分分别能做到 21.26、19.36 和 15.83dB，每种情况下都压过了我们评估的四个无位姿高斯泼溅（pose-free Gaussian splatting）基线。在同一个训练器下，修正图像估计出来的角度，比把这些估计固定不动，平均前景 PSNR 高了 7.88dB。消融研究（ablation study）显示，从图像推出来的角度初始化和共享运动模型（shared motion model），都对提升有帮助。在真实拍摄里，OC-GS 的修正让平均前景 PSNR 提升了 0.70dB。结果说明，在共享运动模型里修正那些不确定的角度，确实能改善稀疏、不规则转台拍摄下的重建效果。

articles.title: Strategically Diverse Sampling for Self-Training
articles.zh: 面向自训练的策略性多样化采样
articles.summary: 如果你在跑自训练但发现模型越训越窄，这篇提醒你采样策略的多样性比数量更关键
articles.author: Alexander Gurung, Esmeralda S. Whitammer 等
articles.body: Many LLM training and inference methods, including RL and test-time scaling, depend on repeated sampling, but benefit only when the responses meaningfully differ. Self-training faces the same challenge: training data is typically constructed by sampling IID responses and filtering primarily for correctness, thereby overrepresenting strategies a model already favours. We investigate strategic diversity, or substantive variation among approaches to a problem, as an alternative principle for constructing self-training data. We generate strategically diverse data with two sampling methods: GROOT, a new method which constructs a hierarchical tree of approaches and samples distinct paths, and Verbalized Sampling (VS), adapted to produce an unstructured set of approaches. Across competitive programming and Next-Chapter Prediction domains, models trained on strategically sampled data outperform IID-trained counterparts on difficult tasks and provide strong initializations for RL and test-time scaling. Most strikingly, self-training on strategically diverse but incorrect traces from Qwen3-4B outperforms IID distillation from a 235B teacher. These results challenge prevailing assumptions about what makes useful self-training data and show that diversity of approaches can matter more than correctness or teacher scale.
articles.bodyZh: 很多大语言模型（LLM）的训练和推理方法，比如强化学习（RL）和测试时扩展（test-time scaling），都得靠反复采样；但只有当模型给出的回答真的不一样时，这些方法才有效。自训练（self-training）也面临同样的问题：训练数据通常是通过独立同分布（IID）地采样回答、再主要按正确性筛选出来的，结果就是模型本来就偏爱的策略被过度代表了。我们研究了一种叫“策略多样性”（strategic diversity）的思路，也就是解决同一个问题时，方法之间要有实质性的差异，把它当作构建自训练数据的一个新原则。我们用两种采样方法来生成策略多样的数据：一个是 GROOT，这是我们新提出的方法，它会先搭建一棵分层的解题方法树，再从中采样出不同的路径；另一个是言语化采样（Verbalized Sampling, VS），我们把它改造成能生成一组不那么结构化的解题方法。在竞赛编程（competitive programming）和“下一章预测”（Next-Chapter Prediction）这些领域里，用策略采样数据训练出来的模型，在难题上比用 IID 数据训练的模型表现更好，而且还能给 RL 和测试时扩展提供很强的初始化。最让人惊讶的是，用 Qwen3-4B 生成的、策略多样但答案不正确的推理轨迹去做自训练，效果竟然超过了从 235B 教师模型做 IID 蒸馏（distillation）。这些结果挑战了人们对“什么样的自训练数据才有用”的普遍假设，也说明方法的多样性可能比正确性或者教师模型的规模更重要。

articles.title: Adapting for AI: How elementary teachers adjust their practices for an AI-integrated curriculum
articles.zh: 为AI而调整：小学教师如何应对AI融合课程带来的教学实践变化
articles.summary: 如果你关心AI进课堂的真实落地，这篇给的是老师视角的一手经验，而不是厂商的宣传话术
articles.author: Fasika Melese, Ruiyang Wu 等
articles.body: Conversational AI tools are entering children's everyday experiences, and schools are interested in adopting them. However, successful classroom integration depends not only on the technology but also on the work teachers do to make it usable and appropriate for their students and classroom context. There is little known about how elementary teachers work as they implement conversational AI tools in real classrooms. In this study, we examine three teachers' experiences implementing an AI literacy and English Language Arts (ELA) curriculum built around ToyTalk, a conversational AI toy development platform, over 13 instructional days, a three-week summer camp. Drawing on daily individual reflections, group reflections, and post-camp interviews, we find that teachers' adaptive practices of repair, differentiation, translation, and balancing sit at the intersection of three tensions (technology, learner, and instruction). Teachers' understanding of AI and their role evolved over the camp experiences. From these findings, we contribute design implications and considerations for deploying conversational AI within elementary classrooms.
articles.bodyZh: 对话式人工智能工具（Conversational AI tools）正在走进孩子们的日常生活，学校也很想把这些工具引进课堂。不过，想在课堂上真正用好，不光要看技术本身，还得看老师们下了多少功夫，把它变得好用、适合自己学生和课堂环境。可我们其实还不太清楚，小学老师在真实课堂里落地这些对话式AI工具时，到底是怎么干的。在这项研究里，我们看了三位老师的亲身经历：他们在为期三周、共13个教学日的夏令营里，实施了一套围绕 ToyTalk（一个对话式AI玩具开发平台）搭建的人工智能素养（AI literacy）和英语语言艺术（English Language Arts, ELA）课程。我们根据老师每天的个人反思、小组反思，以及夏令营后的访谈发现，老师们那些灵活应变的做法——修补（repair）、差异化（differentiation）、转化（translation）和平衡（balancing）——正好卡在三种张力（tensions）的交汇点上：技术（technology）、学习者（learner）和教学（instruction）。经过整个夏令营，老师们对AI的理解、对自己角色的认识，也在慢慢变化。基于这些发现，我们提出了一些设计上的启示和注意事项，供在小学课堂里部署对话式AI时参考。

articles.title: DeepEdu-v1: Efficient and Scalable Agentic LLMs for Vietnamese Education
articles.zh: DeepEdu-v1：面向越南教育的高效可扩展Agentic LLM
articles.summary: 如果你在做小语种教育场景的Agent落地，这篇是一个从数据到架构都考虑成本可扩展性的完整样板
articles.author: Quang Nguyen, Hieu Nguyen 等
articles.body: AI tutoring could markedly improve learning outcomes for students in developing regions such as Vietnam, yet the two obvious paths both fall short. Cloud assistants such as ChatGPT route sensitive student data to foreign servers---violating data-sovereignty laws such as Vietnam's Decree 53---and, pre-trained on Western-centric corpora, are not organized around the national textbook curriculum, so their knowledge of local content is unsystematic and frequently hallucinated. Self-hosting an open model keeps data on-premise but hits a two-fold wall: post-training quantization (AWQ, GPTQ) tames the static weight footprint, yet the dynamic KV cache and prefill latency of long tutoring contexts still cause out-of-memory failures and slow responses on consumer GPUs, while the model keeps hallucinating on region-specific material. We present DeepEdu-v1, an AI-tutoring system for Vietnamese education built on SCALE (Self-improving Context-Aware Learning Engine), a framework with two innovations. First, a long-context inference engine amortizes token selection from per-sub-chunk to per-cluster granularity; on long-context retrieval it issues x7.7 fewer retrieval calls than a state-of-the-art selective-attention baseline, cutting prefill latency (TTFT) by roughly 35% while matching or improving task accuracy. Second, a self-improving agentic layer continuously curates a verified playbook from past interactions instead of fine-tuning, a design intended to progressively reduce reliance on dominant-language priors as trustworthy local knowledge accumulates. In its deployed configuration, DeepEdu achieves a nearly x2 TTFT speedup over standard vLLM serving and lifts agentic accuracy from 70.0% to 79.5% on complex tasks, with the strongest per-track gains across financial-reasoning and interactive-agent benchmarks.
articles.bodyZh: AI辅导有望显著提升越南等发展中地区学生的学习效果，但现有的两条明显路径都走不通。ChatGPT这类云端助手会把学生的敏感数据传到国外服务器上——这违反了越南《第53号法令》等数据主权法规——而且它们是用以西方为中心的语料预训练的，并不是围绕越南国家教材课程来组织的，所以对本地内容掌握得不系统，经常胡说八道。自己托管一个开源模型虽然能把数据留在本地，却会撞上两重墙：训练后量化（AWQ、GPTQ）确实能压住静态权重的占用，但长辅导上下文带来的动态KV缓存和预填充延迟，仍然会让消费级GPU出现内存溢出、响应变慢，同时模型还是会对本地特有内容胡编乱造。我们推出了DeepEdu-v1，这是一个面向越南教育的AI辅导系统，建立在SCALE（自我改进的情境感知学习引擎）之上，该框架有两项创新。第一，一个长上下文推理引擎把token选择从每个子块摊薄到每个簇的粒度；在长上下文检索上，它发出的检索调用比最先进的选择性注意力基线少7.7倍，把预填充延迟（TTFT）削减了约35%，同时任务准确率持平甚至更高。第二，一个能自我改进的智能体层会持续从过去的交互中整理出一本经过验证的攻略手册，而不是去做微调，这个设计的目的在于，随着可信的本地知识不断积累，逐步减少对主导语言先验的依赖。在实际部署配置下，DeepEdu的TTFT比标准vLLM服务快了近2倍，在复杂任务上把智能体准确率从70.0%提升到79.5%，其中在金融推理和交互式智能体基准测试上，各赛道提升最为明显。
